description: KNaV₄H₄O₁₁ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. K is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.75-2.97 Å. Na is bonded in a distorted pentagonal pyramidal geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.51 Å. There are two inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.67-2.05 Å. In the second V site, V is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.66-2.06 Å. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na and three V atoms to form distorted ONaV₃ tetrahedra that share corners with three ONaV₃ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one OV₄ trigonal pyramid, edges with three ONaV₃ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one OV₄ trigonal pyramid. In the second O site, O is bonded to one Na and three V atoms to form distorted ONaV₃ tetrahedra that share corners with three ONaV₃ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one OV₄ trigonal pyramid, edges with three ONaV₃ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one OV₄ trigonal pyramid. In the third O site, O is bonded to four V atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing OV₄ trigonal pyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one K and one V atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent K and one V atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Na and two H atoms.
